interpretation: Do not promote source5ae into PR218. Same-module unattached controls are mixed, and the complete ten-scene comparison retains material ordinary-rotation regressions despite correct queued GPU behavior. Short phase improvements do not establish lower complete-frame latency. The private dynamic-mesh flag remains diagnostic only. No Full run was dispatched for the rejected source.
